scope: Real robots, publicMetadata and sitemap exports; public data readers and Next server-only boundary replaced. No service, deployment or provider request.
regression: An EN presentation for an offer including FR only was listed in the sitemap despite its nonindexable page metadata. Sitemap now reads the detailed offer and matches its included-language rule; unavailable or changed details return 503.
environmentChecks: local/test/staging never index or emit sitemap entries
production uses the configured absolute origin and activated locales only
HTML hreflang includes self and configured available equivalents
unlaunched locale absent from sitemap and alternates

sources.conclusion: A single hreflang method is sufficient; equivalents must include self, be absolute and reciprocal.
A crawler must be able to retrieve a URL to observe its noindex directive; robots disallow is not proof of deindexing.

limits: These are source-level route/metadata tests with replaced data transport, not a production deployment.
Production target is not launched or observed; staging crawling/indexing state in search engines is not measured.
